message.content:
A classic lasagna typically includes these ingredients:

| Category | Typical Items |
|----------|---------------|
| **Lasagna noodles** | 12–15 sheets (regular or no‑boil) |
| **Meat sauce** | 1 lb ground beef or a mix of beef & pork; 1 onion, 2–3 cloves garlic, 1 can (28 oz) crushed tomatoes or tomato sauce, 1 can (6 oz) tomato paste, 1 tsp dried oregano, 1 tsp dried basil, salt & pepper |
| **Ricotta mixture** | 15 oz ricotta cheese, 1 egg, ½ cup grated Parmesan, pinch of nutmeg, salt & pepper |
| **Mozzarella** | 2–3 cups shredded mozzarella (or sliced) |
| **Parmesan** | ½–¾ cup grated (for topping) |
| **Optional extras** | ½ cup chopped spinach or sautéed mushrooms, 1 tbsp fresh parsley or basil, a splash of red wine in the sauce |
| **Seasonings** | Salt, pepper, oregano, basil, nutmeg, optional red pepper flakes |

**Basic assembly steps:**

1. Cook noodles until al dente, drain, and lay flat on a sheet of foil or parchment to keep them from sticking.
2. Prepare the meat sauce: brown the meat with onion & garlic, add tomatoes, season, and simmer for 20–30 min.
3. Mix ricotta with egg, Parmesan, nutmeg, salt, and pepper.
4. In a baking dish, spread a thin layer of sauce, then layer noodles, ricotta mixture, mozzarella, and sauce. Repeat until all layers are used, finishing with sauce and a generous sprinkle of mozzarella and Parmesan.
5. Cover with foil and bake at 375 °F (190 °C) for 25 min, then remove foil and bake another 10–15 min until bubbly and golden.

Enjoy your homemade lasagna!
